name: Site-Finished vs Factory-Finished in Renton: The Long-Term Reality
title-tag: Site-Finished vs Factory-Finished Floors: Renton Guide
meta-description: Factory finish wins year one; site-finished wins year twenty. A Renton refinishing contractor on bevels, recoats, and what each floor costs you decades later.
post-summary: January 27, 2027 · Factory-finished floors win the first year — instant move-in, hardest coating made. Site-finished wins the next twenty: sealed seams, no bevel grooves, recoats at $1.99/sq ft and refinishes at $3.99 instead of replacement. The long-term reality from Renton’s Boeing-era oak to its newest prefinished townhomes.
